description: Features as tabs; the chosen one fills the panel beside or below the tab list.

files.content:
<!-- Code generated by packages/kit-compose/src/organisms.ts from packages/compose-gen/specs (compose-gen organism emitters on kit-compose). DO NOT EDIT. -->
<!--
  Features behind a tab list: the chosen tab shows its text and a picture. The page keeps the chosen tab
  (`active`, empty for the first) and updates it on the `select` event. Axes: panel (split: text beside the
  picture, stack: picture below), tone, density.
-->
<script lang="ts">
import type { Feature } from "./feature-grid.types";

export type FeatureTabsProps = {
  id: string;
  title: string;
  features: Feature[];
  empty?: string;
  tabsLabel: string;
  active?: string;
  panel?: "split" | "stack";
  tone?: "default" | "muted";
  density?: "default" | "compact";
  landmarkLabel?: string;
};
</script>

<script setup lang="ts">
import Grid from "../compose/Grid.vue";
import LucideIcon from "../icons/LucideIcon.vue";
import Stack from "../compose/Stack.vue";
import Text from "../compose/Text.vue";
import Title from "../compose/Title.vue";
import EmptyState from "../components/empty-state.vue";
import MediaFrame from "../components/media-frame.vue";
import SectionFrame from "../components/section-frame.vue";
import Switcher from "../components/switcher.vue";
import SwitcherItem from "../components/switcher-item.vue";

const {
  id,
  title,
  features,
  empty = "",
  tabsLabel,
  active = "",
  panel = "split",
  tone = "default",
  density = "default",
  landmarkLabel,
} = defineProps<FeatureTabsProps>();
const emit = defineEmits<{ select: [id: string] }>();
</script>

<template>
  <SectionFrame :id="id" :title="title" :tone="tone" :density="density" :landmarkLabel="landmarkLabel">
    <EmptyState v-if="((features?.length ?? 0) === 0)" icon="layout-grid" :title="empty" />
    <Stack v-else gap="6" align="stretch">
      <Switcher :label="tabsLabel" class="w-fit max-w-full flex-wrap">
        <SwitcherItem v-for="(f, i) in features" :key="f.id"
          :active="((f.id === active) || (((active as string) === '') && (i === 0)))"
          @click="() => emit('select', f.id)"
        >
          {{ f.title }}
        </SwitcherItem>
      </Switcher>
      <template v-for="(f, i) in features" :key="f.id">
        <Grid v-if="((f.id === active) || (((active as string) === '') && (i === 0)))"
          :cols="(((panel as string) === 'split') ? '1-2' : '1')"
          class="items-center gap-8"
          data-testid="tab-panel"
          role="tabpanel"
        >
          <Stack gap="4">
            <LucideIcon :name="f.icon" :size="24" />
            <Title :as="3" size="2xl" weight="bold">
              {{ f.title }}
            </Title>
            <Text size="base" class="text-muted-foreground">
              {{ f.text }}
            </Text>
          </Stack>
          <MediaFrame :alt="f.title" ratio="4/3" />
        </Grid>
      </template>
    </Stack>
  </SectionFrame>
</template>
